about.title: The Heart Behind Uvita Concierge
story: Behind Uvita Concierge Experience is a passion for tourism, service, and creating meaningful experiences.

With a background in tourism and hospitality, and a deep knowledge of the Uvita area and its surroundings, I've always been drawn to helping people feel comfortable, welcomed, and truly connected to their destination.

After working and gaining experience in the industry, I realized that many travelers were looking for something more than just a place to stay — they wanted guidance, trust, and someone local who could help them make the most of their time here.
That's what inspired me to create Uvita Concierge Experience.
This project was born from the desire to offer personalized attention, connect guests with reliable local providers, and create experiences that feel easy, authentic, and memorable.
Every recommendation, every detail, and every interaction is handled with care, because I truly believe that great service can turn a trip into something unforgettable.
This is more than a service — it's about helping people experience Costa Rica the right way!

whale.metaTitle: Whale Watching in Uvita | Uvita Concierge Experience
whale.eyebrow: Costa Ballena · July to October (approximate season)
whale.heroDesc: Humpback whale watching in their natural habitat, with local operators who prioritize responsible observation.
whale.p1: The Costa Ballena (Whale Coast) owes its name to the silhouette of Uvita's beach, which resembles a whale's tail, and to the humpback whales that visit these waters at certain times of the year. The whale watching tour is done by boat, accompanied by experienced local guides and captains.
whale.p2: Exact season dates, tour duration and sea conditions may vary. All specific information about schedules, prices and availability is confirmed directly with the operator before booking.
includes: Boat departure from the Uvita / Costa Ballena area.
Responsible observation, respecting the distance and behavior of the whales.
Option to combine with snorkeling or beach, depending on the operator.
whale.responsibleP: We work with operators who follow good responsible tourism practices: keeping a prudent distance, avoiding routes that stress the animals and prioritizing the area's marine conservation.

corcovado.metaTitle: Corcovado National Park Tour | Uvita Concierge Experience
corcovado.heroDesc: Unique biodiversity and unforgettable nature, in one of the last great tropical rainforests of Central America.
corcovado.p1: Corcovado is renowned for its extremely high biodiversity: wild cats, monkeys, tapirs, birds and lush vegetation coexist in a single ecosystem. Hikes are always done with authorized guides and respecting the park's regulations.
corcovado.p2: Routes, schedules and entry permits depend on the operator and the current regulations of the National System of Conservation Areas. We confirm these details with you before booking.
corcovado.recNote: These are general recommendations; they do not replace the official guidance of the park or the tour operator.
rec: Closed shoes, ideal for humid trails.

tour-nocturno.metaTitle: Night Wildlife Tour in Uvita | Uvita Concierge Experience
tour-nocturno.heroDesc: When the sun goes down, the rainforest comes to life. Discover frogs, snakes, insects and fascinating creatures with expert local guides.
tour-nocturno.h2: The rainforest that wakes up at night
tour-nocturno.p1: Much of the tropical wildlife is nocturnal. On a guided flashlight walk, the Costa Ballena rainforest reveals colorful frogs, snakes, insects, spiders and sleeping birds you'd rarely see by day. It's a perfect experience for nature photography and for the whole family.
tour-nocturno.p2: Walks are always led by authorized local guides, on safe trails and with full respect for the animals and their habitat. Times, duration and meeting point are confirmed with you before booking.
tour-nocturno.recNote: These are general recommendations; always follow your guide's instructions.
rec: A flashlight or headlamp (some tours include one).
A camera with a good night or macro mode.
Water and a light rain jacket.

spa.metaTitle: Spa & Wellness in Uvita | Uvita Concierge Experience
spa.heroDesc: Massages and spa treatments with jungle and ocean views — relax surrounded by the nature of the Costa Ballena.
spa.p1: Enjoy massages and spa treatments in a unique setting: open-air tables with panoramic views of the rainforest and the South Pacific of Costa Rica. An experience designed to unwind, relax and reconnect with nature.
spa.p2: We arrange the service at villas or at scenic spots, as you prefer, with professional therapists. Tell us what you're looking for (relaxation, couples, groups) and we design the experience for you.
